unit_cn: Unit 6 Earth First 地球优先
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 6 词表(p112-119 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、环境/地球保护主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The great white shark is not the monster films make it out to be.
words.example_cn: 大白鲨并不是电影里描绘的那种怪物。

words.example_en: The film scared many people into hating sharks.
words.example_cn: 那部电影把许多人吓得开始憎恨鲨鱼。

words.example_en: Benchley loved to dive, and on one dive he saw the sea floor covered with dead sharks.
words.example_cn: 本奇利热爱潜水,一次下潜时他看到海底布满了死鲨鱼。

words.example_en: Experts say that sharks do not target humans on purpose.
words.example_cn: 专家说,鲨鱼并不会故意把人当作攻击目标。

words.example_en: Fortunately, more and more people now want to protect sharks.
words.example_cn: 幸运的是,如今越来越多的人想要保护鲨鱼。

words.example_en: Many sea animals are now close to extinction.
words.example_cn: 许多海洋动物如今已濒临灭绝。

words.example_en: People's attitude towards sharks has slowly changed.
words.example_cn: 人们对鲨鱼的态度已经慢慢改变。

words.example_en: She has devoted her life to protecting ocean animals.
words.example_cn: 她把一生都献给了保护海洋动物的事业。

words.example_en: Plastic waste is doing great harm to ocean life.
words.example_cn: 塑料垃圾正给海洋生物带来巨大伤害。

words.example_en: The documentary highlights the cruelty of shark hunting.
words.example_cn: 这部纪录片着重揭示了捕鲨的残忍。

words.example_en: Finning is an act of great cruelty to sharks.
words.example_cn: 割鳍是对鲨鱼极其残忍的行为。

words.example_en: Years of hunting have made shark numbers fall quickly.
words.example_cn: 多年的捕杀使鲨鱼数量迅速下降。

words.example_en: She travels the world giving presentations about ocean conservation.
words.example_cn: 她周游世界,做有关海洋保护的报告。

words.example_en: The nature reserve protects rare plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 这个自然保护区保护着珍稀的动植物。

words.example_en: Lin Feng is a staff member working at the reserve.
words.example_cn: 林峰是在保护区工作的一名员工。

words.example_en: The reserve was established in the year 2000.
words.example_cn: 这个保护区建立于2000年。

words.example_en: Human activity has badly damaged the wetland.
words.example_cn: 人类活动严重破坏了这片湿地。

words.example_en: A long drought left the river almost dry.
words.example_cn: 长期干旱使河流几乎干涸。

words.example_en: Heavy floods have damaged many homes near the river.
words.example_cn: 洪水冲毁了河边的许多房屋。

words.example_en: These changes affect the water supply for people downstream.
words.example_cn: 这些变化影响着下游居民的用水供应。

words.example_en: The drought has cut the water supply to many villages.
words.example_cn: 旱灾减少了许多村庄的供水。

words.example_en: The staff work hard to restore the natural environment.
words.example_cn: 工作人员努力修复自然环境。

words.example_en: They adopt new, sustainable ways of feeding farm animals.
words.example_cn: 他们采用新的、可持续的方式来饲养家畜。

words.meaning_cn: 可持续的;不破坏环境的
words.example_en: We need a more sustainable way of living on the Earth.
words.example_cn: 我们需要一种更可持续的地球生活方式。

words.example_en: Riding a bike helps to reduce your carbon footprint.
words.example_cn: 骑自行车有助于减少你的碳足迹。

words.example_en: Cars and factories produce a lot of greenhouse gases.
words.example_cn: 汽车和工厂会产生大量温室气体。

words.example_en: The brochure lists six things you can do to help the Earth.
words.example_cn: 这本小册子列出了你可以为地球做的六件事。

words.example_en: We can reduce waste by choosing reusable products.
words.example_cn: 我们可以通过选用可重复使用的产品来减少浪费。

words.meaning_cn: 太阳能的;利用太阳光的
words.example_en: Solar panels turn sunlight into clean electricity.
words.example_cn: 太阳能电池板把阳光转化为清洁的电力。

words.example_en: The less energy we use, the less carbon dioxide is released.
words.example_cn: 我们使用的能源越少,排放的二氧化碳就越少。

words.example_en: Thick smog often covers cities with heavy traffic.
words.example_cn: 雾霾常常笼罩着交通繁忙的城市。

words.example_en: The word smog is made from smoke and fog.
words.example_cn: smog 一词由 smoke 和 fog 组成。

words.example_en: Smog can cause severe breathing problems.
words.example_cn: 雾霾会引起严重的呼吸问题。

words.example_en: Dirty air can cause coughs and infections.
words.example_cn: 脏空气会引起咳嗽和感染。

words.example_en: We listened to a lecture about smog and clean air.
words.example_cn: 我们听了一场关于雾霾和清洁空气的讲座。

words.example_en: A student asked the lecturer for permission to interrupt.
words.example_cn: 一名学生请求讲师允许自己插话提问。

words.example_en: The next slide shows the causes of smog today.
words.example_cn: 下一张幻灯片展示了如今雾霾的成因。

words.example_en: The majority of us take steps to save energy.
words.example_cn: 我们中的大多数人都会采取行动来节约能源。

words.example_en: Some so-called green truths are only half true or even false.
words.example_cn: 一些所谓的环保真理只对了一半,甚至完全是错的。

words.example_en: Making a paper bag uses a large amount of water.
words.example_cn: 制作一个纸袋要耗费大量的水。

words.example_en: When you turn off a device, it often goes into stand-by mode.
words.example_cn: 你关掉一台设备时,它常常进入待机状态。

words.example_en: Devices in stand-by mode still use electricity.
words.example_cn: 处于待机状态的设备仍在耗电。

words.example_en: Electricity continues to leak from the device even when it looks off.
words.example_cn: 即使设备看起来已关闭,电仍在不断漏出。

words.example_en: To make sure it is really off, remove the plug from the socket.
words.example_cn: 为确保彻底关闭,请把插头从插座上拔下来。

words.example_en: Pulling out the plug stops the appliance from wasting power.
words.example_cn: 拔掉插头能让电器不再浪费电。

words.example_en: Our class started a campaign to stop wasting food.
words.example_cn: 我们班发起了一场反对浪费食物的活动。

words.example_en: The campaign urges people to save food at every meal.
words.example_cn: 这场活动敦促人们每餐都节约食物。

words.example_en: Each small action contributes to a greener Earth.
words.example_cn: 每个小小的行动都会为更绿色的地球做出贡献。
